verdict.rationale: Manufact lets developers deploy and host their own MCP servers from GitHub or the CLI, each with a public MCP URL [manufact-docs-1, manufact-docs-16, manufact-docs-25]. It also offers one-click install configs for clients [manufact-docs-18, manufact-docs-27] and a 'publish' readiness checklist aimed at platforms like ChatGPT and Claude [manufact-docs-7, manufact-docs-8, manufact-docs-28]. The only discovery surface evidenced is the public mcp-catalog of checklist scores [manufact-docs-33], so publishing for third-party discovery and installation is thin rather than a clear marketplace. missing for 10: a documented public registry/marketplace listing flow, a discovery and search experience for other users, an install-by-others flow beyond your own client configs, and independent corroboration.
